description: The pie chart titled “Token Routing Distribution (FedHLM)” depicts how tokens are distributed across routing destinations, showing 3 slices in total: a dominant green slice labeled “LOCAL” occupying approximately 94.5% of the chart, a smaller red slice labeled “LLM” at about 3.9%, and a thin blue slice labeled “EDGE_P2P” at about 1.6%. Percentage values are printed inside the smaller slices (1.6% and 3.9%), while the large LOCAL slice is labeled externally without an internal percentage label. There is no separate legend, and the small slices appear slightly separated by white borders, with no clear exploded offset beyond the visible slice separation.
